itemized.notes: Richard A. Hyer's SECOND 2026 filing - the post-primary-elimination report ('30 days after withdrawal or Primary Election elimination' marked XX). Same filer habit as his May filing (key 1d5abcae): pages 2 and 3 are his OWN PORTRAIT SPREADSHEETS, not the county's Form A / Form B - here each carries a typed title cell ('Contributions', 'Expenditures') where the county form would print its banner, and a filer-typed 'Total' row. Page order IS form order on this one (contributions p2, expenditures p3) - the OPPOSITE of his May filing, so page position is not a classifier even within one candidate's own filings. Neither sheet has an Address or a state column, so donor_state is honestly BLANK on both contribution rows (left unwritten by the FILER). DATE CONFLICT retained verbatim, not corrected: the certification is dated 5/20/26 while the clerk's red RECEIVED stamp reads JUL 20 2026 and every transaction on the schedules falls in June-July 2026 - the written month is very likely a typo for 7/20/26, but nothing here repairs it. The filer also spells his own office 'Commisioner'. Continuity note for a rollup: this filing's Last Report contributions figure (58,081.31) is higher than the 54,305.00 cumulative on his May filing, so at least one intervening 2026 report exists that is not in this chunk. Candidate street address, City/Zip and home/office phone are BLACKED OUT BY THE COUNTY (government-applied redaction, preserved). SCANNED, not Polimorphic: no text layer over any page, no Polimorphic footer.
